change_summary: Add a PAPER/0u NON_COUNTED CBB full-game research challenger (FG1/FG1C/FG2/FG2C) that diagnoses Nov 24 paper-EV inflation, adds frozen-from-2020-22 rest/travel/neutral/early residual adjustments and outcome-only tail maps, additive cbb_pricing helpers, a dedicated offline unittest workflow, and this review-only governance manifest. Unify every consumer on OWNER_BLEND_WEIGHTS (100/0 through 0/100), delete the obsolete CANDIDATE_BLEND_WEIGHTS and ledger (0,25,...,100) grids, and add a source test that fails if another grid appears. Parse American odds exactly via a quote contract; reject floats, fractional strings, bools and malformed tokens without truncation. Frozen production coefficients and DEFAULT_CONFIG are unchanged. Not a market promotion.
assumptions: This change is a research challenger only. PAPER/0u, official_counted=0, NON_COUNTED. No production coefficient, pin, runner rewire or market promotion follows from this PR.
Frozen model files (sportsedge_cbb_model.py, cbbd_native_score_model.py) and cbb_pricing.DEFAULT_CONFIG are not edited. Added cbb_pricing helpers are additive.
Historical ESPN core-API odds (DraftKings / ESPN BET) are an unadmitted auxiliary comparator, not execution prices or CLV evidence. Close-line CLV is zero by construction.

Unit tests are deterministic and offline. They use in-test synthetic games and the already-committed Nov 24 card fixture at outputs/cbb/card_2026-11-24_45452279760_1.md. They do not fetch the network.
The 2026-27 backtest window was already used for the first confirmatory read; the improvement-pass numbers on that window are labeled confirmatory reuse and are not a fresh holdout.

The independent model still has worse Brier than the market after the improvement pass. Tune-window longshot and favourite maps did not transfer to 2023-27. ML-favourite and market-line over bias remain. Player availability and returning minutes are documented gaps, not filled with leaky proxies.

cbb_run_it.py, cbbd_paper_ledger.py and their tests were updated only to consume the single canonical blend grid and the American-odds quote contract, because this PR merges before #533, #538 and #537. DEFAULT_CONFIG, including blend_weight_model 0.25, is unchanged.

baseline.metric: Nov 24 card (run 45452279760) markets with paper EV above 30 percent
